SimpleTZ timezone parsing broken for positive offsets and minute extraction

#### Description

When parsing timezone strings with SimpleTZ, the code fails with `NameError: name 'minute' is not defined` for various timezone formats. This affects timestamp parsing in GPX files.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy
from gpxpy import gpxfield

# This will fail with NameError
xml = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx>
<trk>
<trkseg>
<trkpt lat="35.794159" lon="-5.832745"><time>2014-2-2T2:23:18-02:00</time></trkpt>
</trkseg></trk></gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(xml)
```

Also fails when trying to format and parse times:

```python
import datetime
from gpxpy import gpxfield

tz1 = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=2))
time_obj = datetime.datetime(2001, 10, 26, 21, 32, 52, 0, tz1)
str_t = gpxfield.format_time(time_obj)
# This will fail
parsed_time = gpxfield.parse_time(str_t)
```

The error occurs when SimpleTZ tries to parse timezone offset strings but the `minute` variable is not defined in the scope.
</issue>
